confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web searches. These returned Numbeo-derived figures republished by Expatica (June 2026 snapshot), plus Idealista, CityCost and Expatexchange guides. Those figures were: cheap meal about €12.5, mid-range meal for two about €40-47, cappuccino about €2.2, and 0.5 L draught beer about €3.1. I converted euros to USD at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR. That rate is my own assumption and was not searched. The RBA search returned AUD/USD 0.6720 for 2026-11-18, and I used that observation as the FX rate. Cocktail and wine by the glass were not found directly. I set the cocktail at about 2.5-3 times the beer price and the glass of wine at about the beer price (a typical Andalusian bar relationship). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings. July in Córdoba is very hot and typically low-to-shoulder season, so the accommodation figures carry the most uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared against other mid-sized Andalusian tourist cities, such as Seville and Granada. Córdoba is typically somewhat cheaper than Seville and Madrid for dining and lodging.
